        # Doubling/Tripling

            c = (k * b) % m

        # Gaps

    x_bases.extend([x for x in range(1, ell) if ell % x == 0])

                res.append(t)

        a, b = terms[1][1], terms[2][1]

        if _coprime(a, m): s += 2

    B_broad = B_broad[:min(len(B_broad), 60)]
